Now I see the issue. The overflow check at line 968 only applies to `fillOutput`, not `limitedOutput`. For `limitedOutput`, the check at line 967 is:
```c
if ((outputDirective == limitedOutput) &&  /* Check output buffer overflow */
    (unlikely(op + litLength + (2 + 1 + LASTLITERALS) + (litLength/255) > olimit)) ) {
    return 0;
}
```

But the check for match encoding at line 1020 is:
```c
if ((outputDirective) &&    /* Check output buffer overflow */
    (unlikely(op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode>>8) > olimit)) ) {
```

The issue is that `matchCode>>8` is not sufficient to check for the full size needed when writing the match length. When `matchCode >= ML_MASK`, the code writes `LZ4_write32(op, 0xFFFFFFFF)` which writes 4 bytes, but the check only accounts for `matchCode>>8` bytes.
